formulas.name: Inner diameter from outer diameter
formulas.description: Shell ID derived when OD and plate thickness are known.

formulas.name: Outer radius from outer diameter
formulas.description: Radius = diameter / 2.

formulas.name: Cone half-angle from radii & height
formulas.description: Slope half-angle of a conical frustum segment.

formulas.name: Dish sphere radius from chord & depth
formulas.description: Spherical cap radius R from half-chord radius r and axial height d.

formulas.name: Next zone elevation
formulas.description: Cumulative elevation of segment top.

formulas.name: Course pitch (height + joint)
formulas.description: Vertical pitch of one brick course including mortar/joint.

formulas.name: Mouth zone total height
formulas.description: Rule: (Transition courses + Steel-clad courses) x (Mouth course height + joint).

formulas.name: Mouth zone start elevation
formulas.description: Elevation where the mouth zone begins below the vessel top.

formulas.name: Barrel tap-pad angular span
formulas.description: Base barrel zone takes the remainder of 360 deg after charge pad and trunnion zones.

formulas.name: Top cone rest-area angular span
formulas.description: Rest area takes 360 deg minus the tap-side span.

formulas.name: Permanent bottom circular area
formulas.description: Flat circular area of bottom safety lining.

formulas.name: Permanent bottom volume
formulas.description: Area x thickness.

formulas.name: Permanent wall slice area
formulas.description: Mid-wall surface area of one axial slice dh.

formulas.name: Permanent wall slice volume
formulas.description: Annular slice volume of permanent wall lining.

formulas.name: Permanent lining brick count
formulas.description: Surface area divided by brick face area plus cutting allowance.

formulas.name: Permanent lining tonnage
formulas.description: Volume (mm3) x bulk density (t/m3) / 10^9.

formulas.name: Required working thickness
formulas.description: Target campaign life x wear rate + minimum residual safety thickness.

formulas.name: Expected lining life
formulas.description: Usable working thickness divided by wear rate.

formulas.name: Hot-face radius at elevation
formulas.description: Inner cavity radius after permanent, backfill and working layers.

formulas.name: Liquid steel bath volume
formulas.description: Heat weight divided by liquid steel density.

formulas.name: Freeboard above bath
formulas.description: Vertical distance from liquid bath level to mouth top.

formulas.name: 1-D total thermal resistance
formulas.description: Conduction through working + permanent lining plus outside convection.

formulas.name: 1-D steady-state shell temperature
formulas.description: Outside steel shell temperature from 1-D heat transfer.

formulas.name: Working thickness needed for max shell temp
formulas.description: Minimum working thickness to keep the shell at or below t_shell_max.

formulas.name: Wear-life balance spread
formulas.description: Percentage life spread between longest- and shortest-lived zones.

formulas.name: Bottom dish depth
formulas.description: Spherical dish sagitta from dish radius and edge radius.

formulas.name: Bottom dish arc length (centre to edge)
formulas.description: Meridional arc length along the spherical dish.

formulas.name: Bottom spherical cap area
formulas.description: Hot-face surface area of the dished bottom.

formulas.name: Number of bottom rings
formulas.description: Concentric rings between the key brick and the bottom edge.

formulas.name: Ring mid-arc position
formulas.description: Meridional arc position of ring i.

formulas.name: Ring plan radius on dish
formulas.description: Horizontal plan radius at meridional arc distance s.

formulas.name: Bricks per ring (approximate)
formulas.description: Ring circumference divided by average brick tangential width.

formulas.name: Cut pieces per ring crossed by stirring elements
formulas.description: Number of stirring elements times cut bricks per element.

formulas.name: Bottom brick approximate volume
formulas.description: Ring radial width x tangential width x working thickness.

formulas.name: Expected extra bricks per ring
formulas.description: Expected brick count growth from one concentric ring to the next.

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Number of wall courses in band
formulas.description: Band axial height divided by course pitch.

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Course mid-elevation
formulas.description: Elevation of the middle of course k.

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Working lining cold-face radius
formulas.description: Radius where the working bricks sit against the permanent lining.

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Working lining hot-face radius
formulas.description: Hot-face radius (proj_factor = cos(phi) if perpendicular to shell, 1 if horizontal).

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Course angular zone arc length
formulas.description: Arc length of an angular sector at a given radius.

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Bricks removed by nozzle in one course
formulas.description: Number of bricks displaced where a nozzle block crosses a course.

formulas.group: 7. Wall Courses (Lower Cone, Barrel, Top Cone)
formulas.name: Trapezoidal brick volume (mm3)
formulas.description: Brick volume in mm3 for UI step BOQ.

formulas.name: Nozzle length through lining
formulas.description: Length of nozzle sleeve/block along its inclined axis.

formulas.name: Nozzle block vertical half-height
formulas.description: Vertical half-band of courses crossed by an inclined nozzle block.

formulas.name: Taphole ramming mass volume
formulas.description: Volume of ramming mix around the taphole block.

formulas.name: Mouth back-filling course volume
formulas.description: Annular filling gap behind a mouth course.

formulas.name: Junction mid-lining radius
formulas.description: Mid-wall radius at a zone transition.

formulas.name: Junction special piece quantity
formulas.description: Circumferential count of transition pieces times transition courses.

formulas.name: Junction / assembly piece tonnage
formulas.description: Piece count x unit volume (dm3) x density / 1000.
